summary: Blue Owl Real Estate Net Lease Trust filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment increases the accordion cap from $5.0B to $6.0B, adjusts borrowing base terms (concentration limits, unencumbered asset pool minimum, removal of prohibited use restrictions, multi-tenant property eligibility), and modifies financial covenants and reporting requirements. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. This is a routine financing amendment with no equity or control-change implications.
